before.observation: The window cannot be resized below its implicit 16:9 dimensions; the Theme preview uses the wide layout.

after.observation: The initial desktop composition remains unchanged.
The floating window resizes; Appearance switches to its compact preview, keeps active theme details visible, and hides the secondary typography sample instead of clipping it.

windowRule: A session-only matching float+center rule was added through hyprctl while validating, then removed with hyprctl reload. No persistent host config was edited.
method: Real host display capture, cropped to the Settings window. The PR QML ran in a separate Quickshell process with a 512 MiB MemoryMax and temporary config/state paths. No theme or other appearance setting was applied.
